description: This file defines the PaypalPayment class, which models a PayPal payment method, extending a Payment superclass and including fields for payerId and paymentToken.

classes.name: PaypalPayment
classes.description: Represents a PayPal payment, extending the Payment class, with fields for payer ID and payment token.

methods.name: setPayerId
methods.description: Sets the payer ID associated with the PayPal payment.

methods.name: getPayerId
methods.description: Retrieves the payer ID associated with the PayPal payment.

methods.name: setPaymentToken
methods.description: Sets the payment token received from PayPal.
